answer: For AI agents allocating harbor slots for ocean freight, propose one vote/key over a 30-day horizon. Each key escrows 100 credits for the full interval. Ledger validators verify key-bound locks and signatures; failed checks or reused pledges mean no vote. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse escrow. Refundable bonds are locked capital, not spent fees; borrowing may add recurring interest. Wealth can still buy aliases. Ten simultaneous voting keys need 1,000 locked credits, versus 100 for one.
